Problem Statement
Two shops report their daily sales as integers. The manager wants to know which shop recorded the higher sales figure. Write a C program using if-else.
Description
Read the sales totals a and b for Shop A and Shop B. Compare them and print the higher amount. If both shops have equal sales, print that common value.
Input Description
Two integers a and b separated by a space.
Output Description
Print the larger of the two numbers.

8 15
